jobs.title: Senior Analyst FP&A
jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior Analyst Financial Planning and Analysis

Position Summary:

The Senior Analyst Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) identifies, models and recommends ideas pertaining to financial risks and opportunities within the business, leveraging the Finance Team as well as cross-functional relationships. Among other responsibilities, the Senior Analyst manages short and long-term forecasts, understands the airline industry and JetBlue’s strategy as it pertains to the competitive landscape and communicates financial plans and concepts to JetBlue crewmembers, including members of the Executive Leadership Team.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Drive departmental operating forecasting (short and long term), ensuring all department forecasts are accurate and communicated to department leadership

- Collaborate with Managers and above to provide strategic guidance and sound business decision support to cost center leaders through proper financial analysis, collaboration and critical thinking

- Prepare material to be presented to Executive Leadership and Board Members including the annual operating plan, quarterly earnings, and monthly business reviews

- Build and maintain strong relationships with the business, communicating effectively to ensure key stakeholders are informed and aligned on financial goals and results

- Fulfill and manage ad hoc requests including complex analysis as requested by Senior Management and projects requiring cross-functional coordination

- Other duties as assigned

Minimum Experience and Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in a related field; OR demonstrated capability to perform job responsibilities with a combination of a High School Diploma/GED and at least four (4) years of previous relevant work experience

- Three (3) years of financial modeling, working with financial systems, analytical reasoning and presentation experience in a professional setting (i.e. FP&A, Corporate Finance, Accounting, Investment Banking, Consulting, etc.)

- Ability to work alongside and communicate effectively with different groups and organizational levels across JetBlue

- Ability to drive results under the tight deadlines

- Strong attention to detail and focus on accuracy

- Ability to multi-task across a variety of projects, departments and timelines

- Proficient Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint

- Available for occasional overnight travel (15%)

- Must pass a pre-employment drug test

- Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which the position is located

- Authorization to work in the US is required, this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

- Master of Business Administration (MBA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or appropriate post-graduate degree or licensing

- Experience querying large data sets using Structured Query Language (SQL) and using analytical tools such as Tableau

- Effective communication across myriad channels and groups including Executive Leadership

- Advanced forecasting and modeling capabilities and financial systems expertise

Crewmember Expectations:

- Regular attendance and punctuality

- Potential need to work flexible hours and be available to respond on short-notice

- Able to maintain a professional appearance

- When working or traveling on JetBlue flights, and if time permits, all capable Crewmembers are asked to assist with light cleaning of the aircraft

- Must be an appropriate organizational fit for the JetBlue culture, that is, exhibit the JetBlue values of Safety, Caring, Integrity, Passion and Fun

- Promote JetBlue’s #1 value of safety as a Safety Ambassador, supporting JetBlue’s Safety Management System (SMS) components, Safety Policy and behavioral standards

- Identify safety and/or security concerns, issues, incidents or hazards that should be reported and report them whenever possible and by any means necessary including JetBlue’s confidential reporting systems (Aviation Safety Action Program (ASAP) or Safety Action Report (SAR))

- The use of ChatGPT or any other automated tool during the interview process will disqualify a candidate from being considered for the position.

Equipment:

- Computer and other office equipment

Work Environment:

- Traditional office environment

Physical Effort:

- Generally not required, or up to 10 pounds occasionally, 0 pounds frequently. (Sedentary)

Compensation:

- The base pay range for this position is between $88,000.00 and $132,000.00 per year. Base pay is one component of JetBlue’s total compensation package, which may also include access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, crewmember stock purchase plan, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, free space available travel on JetBlue, and more.

Position Title: Analyst Financial Planning and Analysis – Loyalty & Revenue

Position Summary

The Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis – Loyalty & Revenue supports JetBlue’s Loyalty and Revenue Management teams through financial planning, reporting, data analysis, and recurring FP&A processes. This role helps connect commercial performance, customer behavior, loyalty activity, and revenue trends to financial outcomes by preparing forecasts, variance analysis, dashboards, and business insights.

The Analyst will partner closely with Commercial FP&A leadership, Loyalty, Revenue Management, Revenue Analytics, Revenue Management Data Science, Accounting, IT, and other Finance teams. The ideal candidate has a strong business foundation, analytical curiosity, and experience using SQL or similar tools to extract, validate, and analyze data. This role is well suited for someone who can work with large datasets, understand business drivers, support recurring forecast processes, and clearly communicate insights to finance and commercial stakeholders.

Essential Responsibilities

- Support recurring FP&A processes for Loyalty, including monthly close support, variance analysis, forecast updates, budget planning, OpEx tracking, CapEx tracking, and performance reporting

- Prepare monthly and quarterly reporting packages that explain financial performance, key business drivers, risks, opportunities, and variances to forecast, budget, and prior year

- Use Excel, Tableau, SQL, and other analytical tools to extract, validate, summarize, and analyze financial, commercial, loyalty, customer, and revenue data

- Analyze drivers of Loyalty and Revenue Management performance, including revenue trends, redemption activity, customer behavior, partner performance, forecast assumptions, investment activity, and cost trends

- Partner with Revenue Analytics, Revenue Management Data Science, Loyalty, and other Finance teams to understand analytical outputs and translate findings into financial implications, forecast updates, and business narratives

- Maintain, update, and improve recurring financial models, reporting templates, dashboards, and process documentation

- Support the development of financial forecasts, annual budgets, long-range plans, and business cases for Loyalty, Revenue Management, Paisly, and other Commercial initiatives

- Assist with ad hoc analysis requested by Commercial FP&A leadership and business partners, including opportunity sizing, sensitivity analysis, trend analysis, and scenario modeling

- Identify data quality issues, process gaps, and reporting inefficiencies; recommend improvements to increase accuracy, consistency, and automation.

- Prepare materials for leadership discussions, including charts, exhibits, variance explanations, and concise written commentary.

- Build strong working relationships across Commercial, Finance, Accounting, IT, Revenue Analytics, and Revenue Management Data Science teams.

- Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Accounting, Mathematics, Statistics, Analytics, Engineering, or another related field; OR demonstrated capability to perform job responsibilities with a combination of a High School Diploma/GED and previous relevant work experience.

- Two (2) years of experience in Finance, Commercial, Revenue Management, Loyalty, Analytics, Consulting, Accounting, or another business-oriented analytical role.

- Experience performing financial analysis, variance analysis, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, business-case support, or performance analysis.

- Experience writing SQL queries or using SQL-based tools to extract, join, validate, and analyze data.

- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including ability to organize data, build analysis, summarize findings, and prepare clear presentation materials.

- Strong analytical skills, including ability to evaluate datasets, identify trends, connect analysis to business drivers, and communicate implications clearly.

- Ability to work with analysis produced by other teams, understand core assumptions, identify key takeaways, and translate findings into financial impact.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain recurring processes with accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities, recurring deadlines, and ad hoc requests in a fast-paced environment.

- Ability to interact with stakeholders at different levels of the organization and build effective cross-functional relationships.

- Proficient with the Microsoft Office suite.

- Available for occasional overnight travel (10%)

- Must pass a pre-employment drug test.

- Must be legally eligible to work in the country in which the position is located.

- Authorization to work in the United States is required; this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications

- Experience supporting Commercial, Loyalty, Revenue Management, airline, travel, subscription, marketplace, customer economics, or revenue-focused business functions.

- Experience using Snowflake, Tableau, Python, Alteryx, Power BI, or similar analytical and visualization tools.

- Experience building or maintaining dashboards, recurring reports, forecast templates, or automated data processes.

- Familiarity with airline commercial metrics, loyalty economics, revenue forecasting, redemption behavior, customer profitability, or partner economics.

- Experience translating complex analysis into concise business commentary, executive materials, or forecast recommendations.

- Demonstrated curiosity about business performance, customer behavior, revenue drivers, and financial outcomes.

jobs.title: Manager Operations Analytics
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Manager, Operations Analytics reports to the Director, Operations Strategy and Engineering and is responsible for JetBlue’s overall Operations Analytics strategy, delivering credible insights, advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and decision-support capabilities that improve operational performance and inform long-term planning, day-of operations, and post-hoc analysis. They represent Operational teams in leading the development and evolution of JetBlue’s Operations Analytics capabilities, including emerging AI-enabled solutions. The Manager serves as a strategic thought partner to Operations leadership, translating complex operational data into actionable insights and recommendations. The role is expected to balance analytical rigor, operational practicality, and business value while establishing standards for analytical quality, modeling, visualization, automation, and data integrity. The Manager is an effective leader whose personal values match JetBlue’s values of Safety, Caring, Integrity, Passion, and Fun.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Conduct strategic, operational, and advanced analytics in support of corporate initiatives and operational performance improvement

- Develop and execute an Operations Analytics roadmap aligned to business priorities, identifying and prioritizing opportunities for analytics, predictive modeling, automation, and AI to improve operational decision-making

- Lead the development, evaluation, and application of predictive models, statistical methods, optimization techniques, simulation, machine learning, and other advanced analytical approaches to solve complex operational problems

- Translate complex operational questions into analytical frameworks, hypotheses, models, and actionable recommendations for Operations leadership

- Identify opportunities to transform recurring analysis, manual processes, and operational decision-making into scalable analytics products, automated insights, and self-service capabilities

- Partner with Information Technology, Data Engineering, Data Science, and operational stakeholders to develop and deploy scalable data and AI platforms that support Operations decision-making

- Assess the costs, benefits, risks, and expected return on investment of corporate initiatives

- Investigate and determine root causes of operational events, performance issues, and failures using data-driven analytical techniques

- Produce operations briefings and executive-level insights for Senior Leadership and the Board of Directors on a weekly, monthly, and quarterly basis

- Serve as a trusted analytical advisor to Operations leaders and functional departments, providing actionable insights and decision support rather than simply fulfilling data requests

- Develop dashboards, data products, and other visualization tools that enable leaders and frontline teams to understand operational performance, drivers, trends, and opportunities

- Collaborate with stakeholders across Operations to establish clear metrics, goals, and analytical standards

- Review and assess regulatory data/reporting policy creation and revisions

- Prepare regulatory reports and data files per government requirements to ensure corporate consistency, data integrity, and compliance

- Stay current on emerging analytics, machine learning, generative AI, and decision-support technologies and assess their applicability to airline Operations data and analytics

- Take a significant role in the development of crewmembers to support their engagement, growth and goal achievement.

- Other duties as assigned

Minimum Experience and Qualifications:

- Proficiency with data visualization and business intelligence tools (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire)

- Demonstrated experience developing or implementing predictive models, optimization techniques, simulation, machine learning, or other advanced analytical methods

- Demonstrated ability to translate analytical results into clear business recommendations and influence decision-making at multiple levels of an organization

- Demonstrated ability to build effective cross-functional partnerships

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills

Position Summary

The Manager, Customer Analytics reports to the Senior Manager, Marketing Analytics and leads the measurement and analysis of Customer behavior across JetBlue's marketing and digital experiences. This role oversees digital performance reporting, customer segmentation measurement, and customer journey analytics to help Marketing understand how Customers engage with JetBlue throughout the path to booking and post-purchase. Through recurring reporting, proactive analysis, and close partnership with Marketing and Product/Technology teams, the Manager identifies behavioral trends, uncovers opportunities to improve digital experiences, and helps optimize Marketing effectiveness through a deeper understanding of the Customer. The Manager is a service-oriented individual who enjoys solving business problems through data analysis and exhibits the JetBlue values of Safety, Caring, Integrity, Passion, and Fun.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Lead the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of reporting that measures Customer behavior, digital performance, and marketing effectiveness across JetBlue's digital experiences.

- Oversee recurring reporting and dashboards that monitor website performance, customer journeys, conversion funnels, digital channel effectiveness, and key Customer engagement metrics.

- Lead reporting and measurement supporting JetBlue's Customer segmentation strategy, helping Marketing understand how different Customer segments engage with digital experiences and respond to marketing initiatives.

- Conduct proactive analyses and analytical deep dives to identify behavioral trends, explain changes in Customer engagement and conversion, and uncover opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness.

jobs.title: Manager, Governance Risk and Compliance (Paisly)
jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Governance Risk and Compliance (GRC) Manager will establish, execute, and maintain Paisly’s global governance, enterprise risk management and operational compliance frameworks as the platform expands its digital travel product offerings across domestic and international markets. Reporting directly to the Head of Legal, this role translates regulatory requirements, privacy mandates and business goals into clear operational controls, risk management programs and policy frameworks.

Working in close partnership with the Cloud Engineering Compliance team, this role acts as a primary bridge between Legal, external auditors and business operations. The ideal candidate provides regulatory and policy guidance to cross-functional teams, while taking ownership of enterprise risk, vendor risk, privacy alignment and corporate compliance operations.

Essential Responsibilities:

- Oversee enterprise risk management by maintaining the master Compliance Obligations Register and proactively identifying, assessing, and monitoring travel e-commerce risks related to fee transparency, consumer protection, and multi-tenant partner integrations.

- Translate regulatory requirements, such as Federal Trade Commission/Department of Transportation (FTC/DOT) travel rules and data privacy mandates, into actionable guidance for cross-functional teams while partnering with Cloud Engineering Compliance to align corporate risk policies.

- Facilitate third-party due diligence and serve as the escalation point for risk concerns, ensuring all vendors complete required vetting and execute necessary agreements, data processing agreements, data structures and algorithms, non-disclosure agreements (DPAs, DSAs, NDAs) to minimize operational risk.

- Evaluate privacy and regulatory compliance across Paisly's international footprint (U.S., EU, UK, Canada) and collaborate with Legal to ensure workflows, customer data handling, and monitoring practices adhere to California consumer privacy act, general data protection regulation, (CCPA, GDPR), and global data protection standards.

- Establish and govern company-wide operational policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs), while coordinating evidence collection and supporting internal and external audits alongside legal and Cloud Engineering Compliance teams.

- Manage state-by-state Seller of Travel (SOT) registrations, renewals, and corporate regulatory filings in partnership with Legal Counsel, while proactively evaluating international licensing requirements to support Paisly's ongoing expansion.

- Develop, implement, and track the completion of mandatory company-wide training programs focused on governance, risk and compliance (GRC), data privacy and ethical compliance.

- Take a significant role in the development of crewmembers to support their engagement, growth, and goal achievement.

- Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Experience and Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Risk Management, Paralegal Studies, Information Security, Legal Studies, or a related field ; OR demonstrated capability to perform job responsibilities with a High School Diploma/GED and at least four (4) years of previous relevant work experience

- Five (5) years of professional experience in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), Enterprise Risk Management (ERM), or Regulatory/Privacy Compliance operations.

- Proven experience evaluating multi-jurisdiction regulatory compliance, privacy frameworks (CCPA/GDPR), and e-commerce/consumer protection rules.

- Proven ability to conduct regulatory analysis and translate statutory requirements into actionable control guidance for business and technical stakeholders.

- Strong collaborative skills with a track record of working effectively alongside technical compliance, engineering, and product teams.

- Excellent project management skills with high attention to detail for tracking regulatory deadlines, vendor reviews, and licensing requirements.

- Must be able to pass a ten (10) year background check
